grammarOverview.title: Grammar & Accuracy Overview
grammarOverview.summary: Maria Fernanda's current B2→C1 work emphasizes accurate control of advanced formal structures and transfer to independent production.
focusPoints: Inversion after negative/limiting expressions: Never have I…, Rarely do I…, Under no circumstances can we….
Auxiliary selection: distinguish do/does/did, have/has/had and modals; after did, keep the base form.
Formal conditional inversion: recognize and produce forms such as Should you need… where appropriate.

teacherFeedback.title: Teacher Feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Maria demonstrates capacity to work with abstract content, academic reading and exam language at B2 with a C1 target. The next advance depends less on learning more rules and more on stabilizing precision, autonomy and transfer to new tasks without immediate support.
